subject: Handshake: invoice streamlining and net-term proposal
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@vectra.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handshake: invoice streamlining & proposed net-term shift for renewal + seat add

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the productive renewal call this morning. Quick follow-up on two billing items we discussed that will make the expansion smooth from an ops perspective:

1) PO and tax docs: please send the signed PO and the W9 for your US entity so we can align invoicing.
2) Invoice routing: you mentioned AP@vectra.ai as the canonical recipient. To avoid delays on the first renewal invoice, can you confirm that address and whether invoices should also be sent to treasury@vectra.ai?
3) Net terms: internally we prefer to keep Net30, but for this renewal and the additional seats we can propose Net45 for the first year as a concession. Please confirm whether Net45 works on your side.

Attachments for our side: renewal SOW v3 (attached in thread). If you can return the signed PO and W9, we’ll queue the first invoice immediately once the term amendment is final.

Next steps I propose:
- You: attach signed PO + W9 and confirm invoice recipient(s).
- Me: once received, I’ll route to finance and confirm invoice timing; Ben will update the billing contact in our system.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — aim to have paperwork closed by Wednesday so the expanded capacity goes live on 6/15.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0179

Attachments: Renewal_SOW_v3.docx (SOW, quote)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@vectra.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mei Huang <mei.huang@vectra.ai>, Finance AP <ap@vectra.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handshake: invoice streamlining & proposed net-term shift for renewal + seat add

On Mon, Jun 4, 2028 at 9:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Oliver —
> 
> Thanks again for the productive renewal call this morning. Quick follow-up on two billing items we discussed that will make the expansion smooth from an ops perspective:
> 
> 1) PO and tax docs: please send the signed PO and the W9 for your US entity so we can align invoicing.
> 2) Invoice routing: you mentioned AP@vectra.ai as the canonical recipient. To avoid delays on the first renewal invoice, can you confirm that address and whether invoices should also be sent to treasury@vectra.ai?
> 3) Net terms: internally we prefer to keep Net30, but for this renewal and the additional seats we can propose Net45 for the first year as a concession. Please confirm whether Net45 works on your side.

Hi Soojin —

Thanks — attaching the signed PO and our W9. We prefer AP@vectra.ai for invoices (cc'd here). Treasury does not need copies for this renewal.

Net45 would be great on our end; I confirmed with finance and they are amenable to Net45 for the first invoice cycle if Redwood can accept that change in the billing record.

One small ask from our procurement team: please include the PO number (PO-789) on the invoice and the invoice should reference the renewal addendum so our matcher sees the commit.

Attaching: Vectra_PO_789_signed.pdf, W9_Vectra_Inc.pdf

Thanks — once you confirm we'll share the final PO routing to our AP portal.

— Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Procurement | Vectra Labs
oliver@vectra.ai

Attachments: Vectra_PO_789_signed.pdf, W9_Vectra_Inc.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Handshake: invoice streamlining & proposed net-term shift for renewal + seat add

Soojin / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up and for getting the PO/W9. Quick ops checklist to make sure Finance will process smoothly once we accept Net45: 

- Add AP contact to billing record: ap@vectra.ai (confirmed by Oliver).
- Invoice note: ensure invoice contains PO-789 and reference to "Renewal Addendum #3" so their matcher can auto-apply.
- Terms: update the billing terms field to Net45 for the upcoming invoice cycle; tag as temporary (12-month effective).
- Tax: W9 attached; confirm entity name in our billing system matches the W9 exactly (Vectra Labs, Inc.).

I've pulled the draft invoice cadence and attached internal instructions for the AR team. Marissa — can you update the billing contact and schedule the first invoice for 2028-06-20 with Net45 terms? If AP portal requires a separate upload, we will need the portal URL (Oliver, can you share?).

If anything blocks, flag here and we’ll loop legal for a quick amendment signature.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: internal_billing_instructions.md

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@vectra.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handshake: invoice streamlining & proposed net-term shift for renewal + seat add

Oliver — great, thanks for the quick reply and for attaching the PO and W9. Confirming the plan below so we all have the same next steps: 

1) Redwood will accept PO-789 and will reference "Renewal Addendum #3" on the invoice.
2) Billing record updated to AP contact: ap@vectra.ai (Ben/Marissa to action).
3) Terms updated to Net45 for the renewal invoice cycle only (Ben to update in AR system).
4) First invoice scheduled: 2028-06-20 (to AP@vectra.ai). Payment due: Net45 from invoice date.

Oliver — if you can send the AP portal link (or confirm there is none), our team will upload the invoice there in parallel. If we don't hear back, we'll send the invoice to AP@vectra.ai and CC treasury@vectra.ai as a precaution.

Thanks everyone — I'll close the loop once finance confirms the invoice was issued. Goal remains: expanded capacity live 2028-06-15 (billing changes will not delay provision).

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

Attachments: Renewal_SOW_v3.docx, Vectra_PO_789_signed.pdf, W9_Vectra_Inc.pdf
